answer: An adversary hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The jetty counter is kept in fable and thread exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2190 identities would post 2920 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
